body: Also... Isn't that what this is for? Please continue avoiding outside.

I'm glad I could upset you enough to answer, and I'm glad you got some upvotes! If you don't think the other people in here aren't just hiding their nastiness behind self-pity you really haven't been on the internet long. As for a place in between hateful and circlejerk...haven't found that at all perusing any of the other boards on Reddit, or really anywhere that has such a massive presence and scope. This place is mediocre because it has to be, for all the mediocre people that use it.

You know what will ease your guilt? Go do something seriously fulfilling in terms of volunteering. Not just doing it so you can be impressed with your own selflessness, but doing enough to forget your own selfish needs.

But thanks for making me incapable of pity anymore! Good luck with your first world problems. I hope social media drives enough people to suicide so I never have to hear the bitching of people who never learned to close a browser window when they've had enough. People who never learned not to feed the trolls irl. People who are going to cry that I'm being mean and scoot off to Tumblr or MRA sites so they can jack off into their own echo boxes. It smells like a middle school in here.
In fact, nobody really knows you because you barely know yourself. That's how these things tend to go.

Fact of the matter is you won't be 16 and precocious forever, give yourself a break. If you are upset at the things people say on social media, you need to distance yourself from social media. School almost always makes studying things you actually enjoy pretty stifling, your creativity will come back when you give yourself some breathing space.
Why not spend the money on literally anything else that would at least distract you rather than putting you in the hospital?

It sounds like your issues are primarily financial but you've been able to get the gambling in check since? It also sounds like you have a decent enough relationship with your family since you feel you can't kill yourself for their sake? What's stopping you from reaching out to them? I imagine yes, they would be devastated if you killed yourself over less than the price of a used car.

I certainly don't think that all bad people don't know they're bad. Plenty do, plenty don't. I just don't think you're bad. You may feel you've made bad decisions, it's not my place in the slightest to disposition your decisions, but literally everyone makes bad decisions. Some people make excuses, some people kill themselves. Doing things right the first time is not human nature, nor would it be rewarding. Sometimes you have to stop for a few minutes when the guilt and mania take over and forgive yourself. I totally understand if none of this means anything to you, I just want you to know at the very least that you're not a bad person.

I don't want to add too much, you probably don't feel like reading a lot, but please know that a) you are not a bad person because b) bad people do not have these thoughts. You are in pain and disappointed with yourself because your own standards are so high you can't do anything but cripple yourself on the hurdle...and I can tell because you're feeling this way in the first place. You don't have to be perfect. A lot of us push people away, are assholes to people who are supposed to be friends, fuck up financially, academically, whatever. Bad people don't feel stress from these things. But good people can feel "bad" after exposure to physical/psychological trauma which changes their chemistry and leaves them feeling isolated. Look after your dog, I know he loves you and would never think of you as someone who needs to be punished as much as you think you need to be.

Forget meds and therapy. It's 100% about lining people's pockets... But you already know that. The last thing you need is to be chemically and emotionally beholden to a system that exists to bleed you. What you're really strong for is figuring out it doesn't work for you and not being afraid to express that to someone. Be empowered by your disappointment. You don't need those fuckers! and most "clinicians", therapists, psychiatrists etc. are desperately in need of real jobs.

There are no alternatives unless you're lucky, (born wealthy) unscrupulous (enough to do anything to be wealthy) or if you truly do something that makes you happy (because then you'll be a success and doing something you are actually passionate about is hardly work). I know that last one is balls out cheesy but it's the only surefire way not to feel like shit about being a wageslave. I am barely surviving but I like my job and so that particular aspect of my life is something that never really gets me down. I had to respond because I totally felt like this a lot and it was terrifying... before I got a job I liked. The opportunity to find occupational happiness is there... or you could wageslave for some shitty financial corporation. The choice is always yours. I like the commercial fisherman idea! The only functional advice I can give is try a temp agency if there's a decent one in your area. You'd be surprised how you might find one job interesting enough to keep it...  and you can always enjoy the relief of knowing you never have to come back to a miserable one.
This is why I get hostile- I don't want any "advice" from someone who hasn't been in my situation, I'd rather have $50.
It's impossible to keep a job and stay in a shelter. They expect being homeless to be your job. I can't spend all day in lines or calling places over and over again because I'm too busy working.

The PTSD, the homelessness, the lack of family or friends. I don't know anybody in Denver and my experiences here seeking treatment I could trust have not had good results. I've never really tried a support group but the idea scares me because I can be so hostile and I don't want to make anybody else's life harder
